description: This Java source file defines the `PartyWorker` utility class which provides various worker methods related to 'Party' entities within the Apache OFBiz framework. The class includes methods for retrieving related entities such as addresses and contact mechanisms, generating IDs, finding parties based on postal addresses and other attributes, and managing relationships between parties.

classes.name: PartyWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling 'Party' related entities and logic within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getPartyOtherValues
methods.description: Retrieves related entities for a given partyId: Party, Person, and PartyGroup, returning a map with specified attribute keys.

methods.name: createClubId
methods.description: Generates a sequenced Club ID string with a specified prefix and total length, including a check digit.

methods.name: findPartyLatestContactMech
methods.description: Finds the latest contact mechanism of a given type for a party.

methods.name: findPartyLatestPostalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the latest postal address for a party.

methods.name: findPartyLatestPostalAddressGeoPoint
methods.description: Retrieves the latest geolocation point associated with the party's postal address.

methods.name: findPartyLatestTelecomNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the latest telecom number contact for a party.

methods.name: findPartyLatestUserLogin
methods.description: Finds the latest UserLogin record for a party.

methods.name: findPartyLastLoginTime
methods.description: Retrieves the last login timestamp of a party.

methods.name: findPartyLastLocale
methods.description: Retrieves the last locale used by the party based on latest login.

methods.name: findFirstMatchingPartyId
methods.description: Finds the first party ID matching address and name criteria.

methods.name: findFirstMatchingPartyAndContactMechId
methods.description: Finds the first party and contact mechanism IDs matching address and name criteria.

methods.name: findMatchingPersonPostalAddresses
methods.description: Returns postal address entries matching address and person name criteria.

methods.name: findMatchingPartyPostalAddress
methods.description: Finds postal address records matching specified address and address line criteria, excluding disabled parties.

methods.name: makeMatchingString
methods.description: Converts an address string into a standardized format suitable for matching, including uppercasing, replacing mapped words, and removing non-word characters.

methods.name: getAssociatedPartyIdsByRelationshipType
methods.description: Retrieves party IDs associated with a given party through specified relationship types, including transitive relationships.

methods.name: findPartiesById
methods.description: Finds parties by ID, optionally searching by identification value and type, with options for searching first by partyId or including all associated IDs.

methods.name: findPartyId
methods.description: Retrieves the partyId for a given ID and optional identification type.

methods.name: findParty
methods.description: Retrieves the party entity (GenericValue) for a given ID and optional identification type.
